# 🚀 NeoStation iOS — Version 0.0.6 (Build 447)

**NeoStation iOS 0.0.6 is now available!** 🎮✨

This update introduces exciting new features, expanded customization options, improved AirPlay support, a new storage management tool, and several improvements to enhance your NeoStation experience.

### 📺 AirPlay & Apple TV
- Improved fullscreen support across the NeoStation interface.
- Better display scaling to reduce unwanted black bars.
- Improved compatibility with external displays and embedded emulators.
- Enhanced AirPlay integration for a better TV experience.

### 🎮 Nintendo 3DS
- Added new language selection settings.
- Added support for importing compressed and uncompressed NAND backups.
- Improved compatibility with data transferred from your own Nintendo 3DS.

### 📚 Books & Manga
- New immersive 3D covers using the original artwork of your books and manga.
- More realistic book-opening and page-turning animations.
- Improved reading experience, navigation, and visual presentation.

### 🎨 Expanded Skin Catalogs
- Added more skin catalogs to NeoStation.
- Expanded the collection of available skins.
- More customization options to personalize your gaming experience.

### 🧹 New Storage Cleanup & Management Tool
- New storage management tool available under **Settings → Tools**.
- Analyze the storage space used by NeoStation.
- Detect temporary files, caches, and potentially unused data.
- Identify unnecessary files and leftover data from previous game imports.
- Review detected files and their sizes before deleting anything.
- Safe cleanup with user confirmation, designed to protect games, save files, BIOS files, and other important data.
- Helps free up storage space and prevent unnecessary data accumulation.

### 🔧 Additional Improvements
- General stability and performance optimizations.
- Various interface refinements and visual improvements.
- Additional compatibility fixes.
- General improvements to the overall user experience.

---

### ❤️ Thank You!

A huge thank you to everyone supporting NeoStation and sharing feedback, suggestions, and bug reports!

Your continued support helps NeoStation grow and improve with every release.

**Enjoy NeoStation iOS 0.0.6!** 🎮✨

**Version:** 0.0.6  
**Build:** 447  
**Platform:** iOS  
**Distribution:** Sideloaded IPA
